professionalSummary: Data Scientist with Chartered Statistician (CStat) accreditation, experienced in building daily item‑level sales forecasts for 140 coffee shops using gradient‑boosted models and external covariates such as weather and local events.
Skilled in measuring forecast accuracy with weighted MAPE and bias, reporting results to supply planners, and explaining forecast changes to operations managers in plain language.
Maintains forecasting code in a Git repository, ensuring version control and documentation of methods.
experienceHighlights: Built daily item‑level forecasts for 140 coffee shops, feeding bakery production plans (src_a93da198bdac).
Agreed weighted MAPE and bias as accuracy metrics with the supply planning team, reporting them every Monday (src_c10c5c34eeaa).
Held Chartered Statistician (CStat) status, awarded July 2023 (src_682da51e45d8).
Conducted monthly sessions with area managers to explain large forecast changes without statistical jargon (src_545e73a66f0c).
